value.title: Git Notes attribution: isolated read-only storage, pure mapping and SDK/CLI composition

value.principles: Git AI is an input format only. New unisphere-loader-git and unisphere-adapter-git-ai depend inward on core; SDK orchestrates injected ports, CLI depends on core/SDK only, app wires concrete implementations. Existing session/snapshot paths remain intact. No git-ai code/dependency/invocation, retired telemetry, broad query CLI or source writes.
value.composition_root: crates/app/src/adapters.rs: existing ADAPTERS registry adds git-ai with SourceRepresentation::GitNotes; run_git_notes invokes an explicit app-owned constructor closure yielding GitNotesCollector<GitObjectLoader,GitAiAdapter,OtlpJsonlWriter> after pure CLI parsing.
contracts: core/src/git_notes.rs: GitNotesScope {repository:PathBuf,notes_ref:String,selection:GitNoteSelection}; selection All or Commits(Vec<String>) of full lowercase 40/64-hex object IDs. Empty Commits means explicit empty selection. Duplicate selected IDs collapse to one observation; deterministic commit order. Absolute UTF-8 repository and full refs/notes/* ref required. Default CLI ref refs/notes/ai; no tracking-ref discovery or aggregation.

GitNotesLimits {max_notes,max_records,max_note_bytes,max_total_bytes,max_listing_bytes,command_timeout_ms}; validate positive limits, compatible note/total sizes and hard ceilings. Defaults 1000 notes, 10000 mapped output records including manifest, 1 MiB/note, 16 MiB total input, 1 MiB Git listing output, 5000 ms/command. Byte, record and timeout overflow is a typed failure, not successful truncation. Input size does not imply encoded size: existing RecordWriter enforces its independent 32 MiB output ceiling before destination writes.

GitNoteRef {repository,repository_id,notes_ref,notes_tip,target_commit,note_blob}; repository is canonical caller-selected local directory, repository_id is canonical Git common directory (local identity only, not remote URL/global ID). GitNotesListing additionally carries worktree_root:Option<PathBuf>, git_dir:PathBuf, notes_tip:Option<String>, notes:Vec<GitNoteRef> and normalized selection. Resolve true canonical worktree top-level, per-worktree Git directory and common Git directory via Git, including nested caller paths, bare repositories and linked worktrees. Missing valid notes ref: None tip; present empty projection: Some tip.

Core GitNoteLoader trait: list_notes(&GitNotesScope,GitNotesLimits)->Result<GitNotesListing,GitNotesError>; read_note(&GitNoteRef,GitNotesLimits)->Result<LoadedGitNote,GitNotesError>. LoadedGitNote {source:GitNoteRef,bytes:Vec<u8>}. Concrete unisphere_loader_git::GitObjectLoader::new(PathBuf) receives one explicit absolute Git executable; constructor does not execute it. SDK consumers inject that executable directly, with no Git AI lookup or dependency.

Concrete CLI entrypoint crates/cli/src/git_notes.rs: run_git_notes<C:GitNotesApi>(args:Vec<OsString>,context:&CliContext,make_collector:impl FnOnce(Option<PathBuf>)->Result<C,GitNotesError>,stdout:&mut dyn Write,stderr:&mut dyn Write)->u8. Its dedicated Clap parser validates before invoking the app-owned constructor closure; help and invalid syntax require neither Git nor a backend. The closure is a statically typed injection seam, not a service locator or additional factory trait.

Git Notes CLI grammar: unisphere sessions list --adapter git-ai --repo PATH [--notes-ref refs/notes/ai] [--commit FULL_OID ...] [--git-executable ABSOLUTE_PATH]; sessions export has the same selection plus --include-content and optional create_new --output FILE. Expose all GitNotesLimits as matching long flags. --git-executable rejects relative values; absent flag lets app resolve standard git from captured PATH. Missing/non-executable Git is GitUnavailable; no git-ai executable or installed-state probe. Sealed positive proof passes the actual standard Git absolute path explicitly while PATH stays empty; missing path and unavailable PATH are separate negatives.

App routing reuses requested_session_adapter(&args), then the GitNotes registration calls run_git_notes with its concrete constructor closure. Add SourceRepresentation::GitNotes, one registry row, and an unreachable-for-GitNotes rejection in run_with_snapshot. Leave existing sessions.rs run_sessions, snapshots.rs run_snapshot_sessions, their parser shapes and prior invocations unchanged. App is the only executable/environment resolution owner. No broad query/search/filter/extraction path.

GitAiAdapter DESCRIPTOR: id git-ai; application Git AI; description independently read local commit-attached authorship notes, not complete conversations; locations [] because repositories are explicitly selected, not HOME-discoverable. capabilities: export_platforms [unix], output_formats [otlp-jsonl], sdk_caller_owned_cursor false, cursor_source_assumption pinned_git_notes_ref, cli_persisted_resume false, delayed_revision_reconciliation false, lossless_archive false. adapters list stays static with existing envelope; there is no new location-base/storage-format vocabulary because locations is empty.

Registry fixture integration: keep the existing byte-fixture field as synthetic note payload for GitNotes. production_catalog_ids_match_exported_provenance matches GitNotes to a shared testkit ordinary-Git temporary-repository fixture instead of writing --input; invoke --repo and explicit --git-executable, with include-content. Existing byte/SQLite fixture paths stay intact. Assert required common provenance plus Git object-native keys, no offset. adapter_catalog.rs includes git-ai presence/descriptor capabilities and empty locations without weakening hostile-environment invariance or fabricating location hints. External proof independently exercises the actual registered executable path.

Core GitNoteAdapter trait: name()->&static str; map_note(&LoadedGitNote,MappingOptions,GitNotesLimits)->Result<Vec<TelemetryRecord>,GitNotesError>. GitAiAdapter independently parses authorship/3.0.0 with exact standalone --- divider, normal unquoted and optionally quoted paths, positive single-line numbers (42), inclusive ranges (1-4) and comma-separated combinations sorted within each attestation. Legacy 16-hex and documented 7-hex keys are preserved verbatim (spec section1.2.3.1 line193); s_<14hex>::t_<14hex> and h_<14hex> route to their maps. No key padding, conversion or private-cache lookup. Mixed maps are supported; absent/null optional fields remain absent/null. Structurally malformed data and unsupported schema/shape variants fail explicitly.

Valid unresolved attestation keys remain line-attribution evidence: emit native key, native prefix kind and range with unisphere.git_ai.identity_resolution=unresolved, omitting unavailable identity/model/tool values. Resolved keys use identity_resolution=resolved. Emit declared identity records even without attestations. Never skip keys or search another note/cache to synthesize identity. Commits-only storage scope is separate: a selected note targeting a present non-commit object fails UnsupportedTarget; a missing target/object fails ObjectRead. All selection aborts rather than silently dropping those targets; explicit Commits ignores unrelated targets outside selection.

GitNotesApi: list_notes(&GitNotesScope,GitNotesLimits)->Result<GitNotesListing,GitNotesError>; collect_notes(&GitNotesRequest,&mut dyn Write)->Result<GitNotesCollection,GitNotesError>. Request owns scope,limits,MappingOptions. SDK GitNotesCollector::new(loader,adapter,writer) validates all injected results, loads/maps the whole bounded selection, then calls existing RecordWriter::write_batch once. Failure before write emits no telemetry; write/flush failure returns no accepted collection and may leave partial destination bytes for caller discard. No persisted cursor/history or exactly-once guarantee.

Every emitted record, including closing manifest, carries unisphere.profile.version integer1, unisphere.source.adapter=git-ai, unisphere.source.path=canonical selected repository directory, unisphere.source.format=git_notes, and unisphere.source.kind one of note_metadata, declared_identity, line_attribution, notes_manifest. No source.offset, timeUnixNano, traceId, spanId, duration or token totals are fabricated.

All records carry unisphere.git.repository.id=canonical common Git directory and unisphere.git.notes.ref=requested full ref. Note-derived records additionally carry unisphere.git.notes.tip=pinned ref commit, unisphere.git.commit=target commit, unisphere.git.note.blob=blob ID; source.revision=note blob. source.key is $note, metadata/<prompts|sessions|humans>/<native-key>, or attestations/<file-ordinal>/<entry-ordinal>/<range-ordinal> (structural locations, never byte offsets). Events are unisphere.git_ai.note, unisphere.git_ai.identity and unisphere.git_ai.attribution. Attribution adds unisphere.git_ai.file.path, attestation.key, identity.kind, identity_resolution, optional native session.id/checkpoint.id and line.start/line.end inclusive integers. Native checkpoint IDs stay namespaced strings, not OTel IDs.

SDK closing event unisphere.git_notes.snapshot has source.kind=notes_manifest, source.key=$git-notes, source.revision and unisphere.git.notes.tip equal pinned ref commit or explicit null for absent ref, and no commit/blob/body/timestamp. Fields: unisphere.git_notes.semantics=replace_projection; records=number of preceding projected records; notes=number of selected notes; selection={repository,notes_ref,mode:all|commits,commits:[normalized requested IDs] when mode=commits}; include_content=applied bool; finality=unknown; ref_state=present|missing. Each field after the prefix is under unisphere.git_notes. Replacement is scoped to repository/ref/selection, never whole session history. Empty selections and absent refs still emit the manifest; consumers must accept the complete batch before replacing that selected view.

Metadata allowlist retains native keys, supplied agent tool/model/conversation identity and declared numeric statistics without zero filling. human_author, author, custom_attributes, legacy messages and messages_url require include_content even on identity records; URLs are inert strings, never fetched. Null becomes existing empty OTLP AnyValue, missing attributes stay missing. Source paths/IDs remain metadata, not anonymity. Note attribution is not proof of conversation completeness or lack of AI activity.

Unix-only GitObjectLoader; core, pure mapper and writer remain platform-independent for supplied data. std::process::Command uses argv, env_clear, LC_ALL=C, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, no inherited repository/config/trace/helper variables, pager/prompts/replacement objects/optional locks/lazy fetch disabled, protocol.allow=never and hooks/fsmonitor disabled. Ref syntax validation precedes resolution. Inspect effective local/worktree promisor/partial-clone configuration and refuse before object access. Do not override safe.directory or broaden trusted ownership; classify Git dubious-ownership refusal as UnsafeRepository with fixed guidance to use a caller-owned checkout or have the operator separately establish trust. No global config mutation.

Pin the requested ref commit once. All uses bounded ls-tree -r -z enumeration at that immutable tip, decoding canonical two-hex Git-notes fanout and validating selected blob/commit types. Commits and read_note membership use selective nonrecursive ls-tree -z queries: at each pinned tree query only full remaining OID suffix and next two-hex directory using literal pathspecs; follow matching tree by object ID, at most OID-length/2 levels. Never enumerate all siblings for a selected commit; no match is absent note, duplicate representations/invalid matching entries are explicit invalid data. List byte bounds apply cumulatively to returned selected entries; full enumeration retains its own bound. Read cat-file blob without filters/textconv; bounded stdout/stderr capture plus deadline kills/reaps failed child.

Output-file safety is enforced before create_new: use resolved canonical worktree_root (if present), per-worktree git_dir and common repository_id from list_notes; resolve the existing destination parent canonically and reject any destination underneath any of those source roots, including nested --repo input and symlinked parent aliases. Reject existing leaf files/symlinks. SDK never opens output paths; caller-supplied Write remains caller-owned. CLI canonicalizes and then opens an explicit new destination; concurrent malicious destination-parent replacement is outside the caller-owned output-directory assumption, documented rather than claimed race-proof.

Errors expose typed InvalidInput/InvalidRef, GitUnavailable, UnsafeRepository, ObjectRead, Timeout, UnsupportedPlatform, UnsupportedRepository, UnsupportedTarget, UnsupportedFormat, NoteLimit/ListingLimit/BatchLimit/RecordLimit, InvalidData and wrapped existing PipelineError output failures; fixed safe messages only, no raw Git stderr/note text or invented byte offsets. Missing valid ref and empty selection remain successful distinguishable results.

Readiness composition adds git-notes to existing boot proof modes and its 600000ms lane, after native; retains all previous modes. Successful scope is configuration-native-sessions-and-git-notes. Limitations explicitly include Unix local commit-note attribution only, no Git AI dependency, no remote access/reconstruction/complete conversations, no persisted resume/history/finality, metadata is not anonymity, and no claimed network-denial trace. Regression must prove Git Notes failure prevents ready=true with child evidence retained, not merely pin changed scope wording; remove wording-only scope assertion instead of repinning it.
